svg.title: KAI design sheet
svg.text: 19 · student · two minutes on screen · shape idea: the slouched triangle
THE QUIET CAR · character design · v1
Wide base, narrow top; seated he
#CFE0F5 cold blue-white; red ONLY on end-call
#1A1817 black, messy, falls in his eyes
a bit of a show-off, plainly somebody's son.
Cast and design for charm, not edge: soft round
Thumb-glow: his face is lit from below by the
phone in the opening. That light is the car's
only competitor, and the car takes it away.
No logos, no red anywhere: laces, sole, phone
His empty seat must read instantly, so his
hoodie's grey is lighter than the teal moquette.
